question: Which of the following pairs of elements belonging to the same group exhibit similar chemical properties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**N and P**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Columns **in the periodic table are called **groups** because of their **similar chemical behavior.**
 
• **All the members of a group of elements** have the **same number of valence electrons** and similar chemical properties.
 
• Here **Nitrogen and Phosphorus** belong to **group 15** of the Modern Periodic table.
 
• As a result, they exhibit almost the same characteristics.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Carbon(C) belongs to Group 14 and Chlorine (Cl) belongs to group 17.
 
• Lithium (Li) belongs to the group and Kriptanium(Kr) the group 18.
 
• Magnesium belongs to group 2 and Manganese(Mn) belongs to group 7.​
